Frequently asked questions

Frequently asked questions

We look forward to your enquiry. Appointments are confirmed only after direct agreement.

How do I book an appointment?+
Complete an enquiry form. Once enquiries are enabled, the salon can respond and agree on a time with you.
Are prices available?+
Pricing will be published after confirmation from the salon.
Where are you located?+
Skinlogic is located at Ilica 99 in Zagreb.
Which treatment is right for me?+
We recommend discussing your needs with the salon, especially for treatments requiring a skin suitability assessment.
